decisions.reason: As a large fittings producer with strong in-house R&D and broad established knowledge in door hardware, the firm can readily absorb market feedback on this classic handle and integrate it into its core range.

This door lever handle family is very close to the firm's existing competencies and supports portfolio breadth for architects and project developers, so management would usually retain it while learning from early sales and specification experience.
Because this door handle design builds directly on the firm's design, engineering and certification capabilities, it fits high absorptive capacity conditions and is worth keeping in the market.

The product is closely related to the firm's established offer and can be improved through existing design and technical know-how, which makes continuation the likely choice absent clear failure signals.
A lever handle family strengthens system breadth across building types and budget levels and lies squarely within the firm's accumulated knowledge base, favoring retention.

The electronic access system is close to the firm's existing offer, leverages its own R&D and patented engineering, and matches the strategic move toward digital building organization, so management would keep developing it.
